subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Zephyrus Health / Redwood
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Li <susan.li@zephyrushealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Zephyrus Health / Redwood

Hi Susan -

Thanks again for the call today. Really appreciate you walking through Zephyrus' use case and the timeline. Per our discussion, I'm kicking off the vendor security questionnaire so your security team has everything they need to evaluate Redwood.

Attached is our SIG/consensus starter (PDF) and a short SOC 2 summary. Quick notes from the call for context:
- Primary workload: clinical summarization + secure embeddings for provider search
- Expected production go-live: Q3 2027
- Data type: PHI will be used in a subset of downstream features - HIPAA scope likely required
- Required residency: US-only for PHI workloads (will confirm exact regions)

What I need from you to speed things up:
1) Confirm which questionnaire you prefer (SIG vs. CAIQ vs. your custom sheet). We can complete SIG first and map to others.
2) Security contact for formal routing and an expected completion timeline (we usually aim for 2 weeks for the starter answers).
3) Any specific scope boundaries (prod vs. staging, retention windows) we should note up front.

If it helps, Camila (cc'd) is our security/compliance PM and can take point on the SIG. We can also pre-fill answers for common items (SOC 2 coverage, encryption at rest/in transit, incident response).

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Request_20270401.pdf (starter), Redwood_SOC2_Summary_202703.pdf

Next steps: once you confirm the preferred questionnaire and contact, Camila will send the editable SIG and a proposed timeline.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference - Make high-performance inference predictable and economical
From: Susan Li <susan.li@zephyrushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@zephyrushealth.com>, security@zephyrushealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Zephyrus Health / Redwood

Hi Evelyn -

Thanks for sending this over and for the recap - very helpful. We'll go SIG first (that maps best to our intake).

I copied our security lead (security@zephyrushealth.com) and Alex (ops) - they want to confirm a couple of scope items before we hand this off:
- Confirmed: PHI will be in scope for production only; for the pilot we'll use de-identified data.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood's SOC 2 covers data processed in both hosted and dedicated deployments, or only the hosted API?
- For HIPAA: do you have a standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) or do we need to kick off a redline cycle?
- Data residency: we need explicit regional options (us-east-1, us-west-2) for PHI - is that supported on Redwood Private or Dedicated today?

If you can answer these high-level items it will help our security team prioritize the SIG. For timeline, we typically ask for 10 business days to review answers.

Best,
Susan Li
Director, IT Security | Zephyrus Health
phone: +1 (206) 555-2310

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Li <susan.li@zephyrushealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Zephyrus Health / Redwood

Hi Susan / Alex / security team -

Thanks for the quick follow. Answers inline below to help your security triage:

- SOC 2 scope: Our SOC 2 Type II (issued 2027-03) covers Redwood's hosted API plus our control plane. Dedicated and Private deployments are supported via our Private offering; the SOC 2 report includes controls around our on-prem orchestration and customer-managed instances where relevant, but for Dedicated/Private we also provide architecture diagrams and a responsibilities matrix. I'll attach the SOC 2 summary (attached) and Camila can provide the full report under NDA if needed.

- BAA / HIPAA: We have a standard BAA template. For logos/enterprise agreements we typically run a redline cycle, but the template covers HIPAA obligations - happy to route that now.

- Regional support: For PHI we support US regions (us-east-1, us-west-2) via Dedicated and Private deployments today. Hosted API is available in redundant regions but for strict residency we recommend Dedicated or Private. Camila, can you confirm the exact region list and whether we have a partners' region mapping doc?

- Scope: Pilot with de-identified data is fine. For production PHI, we'll note PHI-in-scope and keep retention windows configurable; happy to capture your retention requirement in the SIG.

Proposed next steps:
1) Camila will send the editable SIG and pre-fill ~40% of the answers (SOC 2, encryption, vulnerability management, IR).
2) We'll add a BAA template to the packet if you want to start redlines in parallel.
3) Please confirm a 10 business day review window and the primary security contact for follow-ups.

Camila - please send the editable SIG and include a short readout of which items typically take longest (third-party attestations, encryption key management, data residency specifics).

Thanks -
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
